cli_telnet_port.label: Classic Squeezebox CLI Port
cli_telnet_port.description:
Some slimproto based players require the presence of the telnet CLI to request more information. 

By default this CLI is hosted on port 9090 but some players also accept a different port. Set to 0 to disable this functionality.

Commands allowed on this interface are very limited and just enough to satisfy player compatibility, so security risks are minimized to practically zero. You may safely disable this option if you have no players that rely on this feature or you don't care about the additional metadata.

cli_json_port.label: JSON-RPC CLI/API Port
cli_json_port.description:
Some slimproto based players require the presence of the JSON-RPC API from LMS to request more information. For example to fetch the album cover and other metadata. 

This JSON-RPC API is compatible with Logitech Media Server but not all commands are implemented. Just enough to satisfy player compatibility. 

By default this JSON CLI is hosted on port 9000 but most players also accept it on a different port. Set to 0 to disable this functionality.

You may safely disable this option if you have no players that rely on this feature or you don't care about the additional metadata.

discovery.label: Enable Discovery server
discovery.description:
Broadcast discovery packets for slimproto clients to automatically discover and connect to this server. 

You may want to disable this feature if you are running multiple slimproto servers on your network and/or you don't want clients to auto connect to this server.

port.label: Slimproto port
port.description: The TCP/UDP port to run the slimproto sockets server. The default is 3483 and using a different port is not supported by hardware squeezebox players. Only adjust this port if you want to use other slimproto based servers side by side with (squeezelite) software players.

display.label: Enable display support
display.description: Enable/disable native display support on squeezebox or squeezelite32 hardware.

visualization.label: Visualization type
visualization.description: The type of visualization to show on the display during playback if the device supports this.

preset.label: Preset {0}
preset.description: Assign a playable item to the player's preset. Only supported on real squeezebox hardware or jive(lite) based emulators.

manifest.description: Stream music to Squeezelite and some legacy Squeezebox players on your local network using the slimproto protocol.
